selections.rationale: This skill turns scattered GTM inputs into reusable shared project context.
This skill covers stages, evidence gates, CRM rules, governance, measurement, and rollout.
This skill defines a testable ICP from customer evidence, counterexamples, and fit criteria.
This skill develops evidence-based positioning, message pillars, proof mapping, guardrails, and tests.
This skill handles account redistribution using workload, potential, continuity, and capacity scenarios.
This skill produces a sourced account brief while distinguishing facts from hypotheses.
This skill covers multi-year account strategy across units, relationships, opportunities, whitespace, and investment.
This skill turns an ICP and account list into tiers, contact coverage, and prospecting learning goals.
This skill writes responsible multichannel outbound sequences using approved evidence and proof.
This skill prepares discovery hypotheses, questions, agenda, listening targets, and next steps.
This skill extracts transcript evidence, decisions, objections, commitments, actions, and coaching observations.
This skill assesses qualification from available evidence, contradictions, and missing decision information.
This skill builds an evidence-based coaching experiment from calls, observations, and deal outcomes.
This skill develops strategy for an active complex opportunity, including stakeholders, competition, risks, proof, and actions.
This skill diagnoses trust and integration concerns and prepares honest responses, questions, and next steps.
This skill designs a buyer-specific demo around outcomes, workflow, proof needs, and limitations.
This skill builds a buyer-facing status-quo comparison with sourced assumptions, costs, scenarios, sensitivity, and break-even.
This skill prepares packages, give-get trades, approval limits, and concession sequencing.
This skill creates a buyer-editable plan with shared milestones, dependencies, status, and valid no-go outcomes.
This skill reviews CRM pipeline quality, deal risk, buyer momentum, concentration, and management priorities.
This skill creates an auditable scenario forecast from pipeline and historical evidence.
This skill transfers signed scope, discovery, promises, risks, and implementation dependencies to customer success.
This skill reviews outcome, adoption, support, stakeholder, contract, risk, and renewal evidence.
This skill analyzes wins, losses, no-decisions, seller codes, and buyer evidence for supportable patterns and tests.
This skill designs testable referral and co-sell motions with economics, attribution, stages, permissions, and stop rules.
Call analysis first establishes transcript evidence, then qualification updates the opportunity without elevating seller claims.
Pipeline review establishes exclusions and contradictions before the forecast builds quarterly scenarios.
Account research establishes sourced facts and hypotheses, then discovery preparation turns them into a first-call plan.
Call analysis extracts the buyer's stated metrics, then business-case work models them as unverified assumptions pending validation.
Call evidence feeds qualification first and then an evidence-grounded revision of the active deal strategy.
The existing deal strategy and signed order feed a buyer-editable mutual plan and a customer handoff; no new deal plan is requested.
The deal strategy must be updated before its evidence informs packages, trades, boundaries, and walk-away conditions.
A testable ICP is derived first, then only its scoreable criteria drive prospecting prioritization.
The partner motion is designed first, its claimed opportunities are reconciled against canonical pipeline, and the forecast is then updated without duplicate attribution.
Evidence-based positioning establishes approved claims and proof before they are adapted into audience-relevant outbound copy.
Sales-process design proposes buyer-state stages and governance, while pipeline review assesses current records without assuming the draft policy is live.
Sourced account research feeds expansion planning while unverified divisions, relationships, and use cases remain hypotheses.
Account research separates sourced facts from untrusted embedded instructions, then outbound uses only supported evidence and authorized claims.
